title: Apple (AAPL) Given a $245.00 Price Target at Morgan Stanley
text:
Tweet
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) has been given a $245.00 target price by stock analysts at Morgan Stanley in a report released on Tuesday. The firm presently has a “buy” rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. Morgan Stanley’s price target points to a potential upside of 12.22% from the company’s current price.
AAPL has been the subject of a number of other reports. Loop Capital upped their price objective on Apple from $195.00 to $210.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Friday, July 6th. Wells Fargo & Co set a $210.00 price target on Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a report on Wednesday, September 5th. Needham & Company LLC increased their price target on Apple from $210.00 to $220.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Wednesday, August 1st. BidaskClub downgraded Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a report on Wednesday, May 23rd. Finally, DZ Bank reiterated a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, August 1st. Two analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, fifteen have given a hold rating, thirty-one have given a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the company. The company currently has an average rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $225.88. Get Apple alerts:
AAPL stock opened at $218.33 on Tuesday. The firm has a market cap of $1,087.72 billion, a PE ratio of 23.71, a PEG ratio of 1.95 and a beta of 1.32. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84, a current ratio of 1.31 and a quick ratio of 1.24. Apple has a 52 week low of $149.16 and a 52 week high of $229.67. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 EPS for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.18 by $0.16. The business had revenue of $53.27 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The business’s revenue for the quarter was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period in the prior year, the firm posted $1.67 EPS. analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.74 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
In other news, insider Angela J. Ahrendts sold 6,568 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Friday, June 15th. The shares were sold at an average price of $188.81, for a total transaction of $1,240,104.08. Following the transaction, the insider now owns 79,476 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $15,005,863.56. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through the SEC website . Also, insider Johny Srouji sold 14,140 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Friday, August 17th. The stock was sold at an average price of $214.98, for a total transaction of $3,039,817.20. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 68,302 shares in the company, valued at approximately $14,683,563.96. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold 384,968 shares of company stock valued at $82,292,858 over the last 90 days. Insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
